description: This Ruby script identifies unused resources (like strings and layout IDs) within Android applications' resource directories. It parses XML files, Java files, and the AndroidManifest.xml to find references to resources and reports which are unused.

classes.name: UnusedResources
classes.description: Data holder class storing app directory and collections of unused layout and string IDs.

classes.name: FilePosition
classes.description: Represents a position in a file with filename and line number, supports comparison and string representation.

methods.name: findResDirectories
methods.description: Recursively finds all 'res' directories within a given root directory.

methods.name: findAllOccurrences
methods.description: Finds all matches for a given regex in a string, returning the captured groups.

methods.name: recordJavaUses
methods.description: Scans Java files matching a glob pattern to record used resource IDs in a global hash.

methods.name: findUnusedResources
methods.description: Main logic to parse resource XML files, Java files, and manifest to determine unused resource IDs.

methods.name: findApps
methods.description: Finds all application directories containing 'res' folders within a base directory.

methods.name: displayText
methods.description: Outputs the unused resources in plain text format.

methods.name: displayHtmlUnused
methods.description: Outputs a section of HTML listing unused IDs.

methods.name: displayHtml
methods.description: Generates complete HTML output listing all unused resources.
